alt_text: Cover: How to revise any topic, a 5-step checklist, for any subject at any level.
Step 1, map it: list the big ideas on one page and how they link. Step 2, explain it in your own words with the book closed. Each step has tick boxes.

Step 3, test yourself with your notes closed, then check. Step 4, fix your mistakes by writing down why each was wrong. Testing yourself beats rereading. Rereading can feel like more learning than it is.
Step 5, come back a few days later and again a week later, plus a 5-item checklist to tick before a test.
